[Download the printable entryway plan (PDF)](<<TEMP>/T/selfrec-work-<SESSION>/Entryway plan.pdf>)

The plan uses a **29-inch-wide freestanding console** that needs no wall holes. It clears the 16-inch door swing by half an inch. Its 12½-inch depth leaves half an inch for baseboard clearance within the 13-inch projection limit.

Each adult gets a row for two pairs of shoes and space for one shoulder bag. Keys and a folded umbrella share one end of the top, leaving **21 × 12½ inches clear for standing mail sorting**. Mail to keep slides into the slot directly below.

The three-page PDF includes dimensioned drawings, a cut list and assembly instructions. Before cutting, use the included mock-up checks to confirm the baseboard clearance, fit both residents’ belongings and try the proposed 39-inch sorting height.
